body:
Wightborne Armiger
CR 14

XP 38,400
Male Wightborne armiger 13
LE Medium undead (elf)
Init +19; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 27, flat-footed 25 (+7 armor, +2 deflection, +8 Dex, +6 natural; +4 shield if wielding spiked chain)
hp 147 (13d10+65)
Fort +15, Ref +18, Will +9
Defensive Abilities unarmored training (+7); Immune undead traits
Weaknesses resurrection vulnerability

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +3 elven curve blade (liquimetal blanch modification) +24 (1d10+10/18-20/x2) plus energy drain; (power attack, furious focus +24 (1d10+22/18-20/x2)) or; +3 elven branched spear (extending framework modification) +24 (1d8+10/x3) plus energy drain; (power attack, furious focus +24 (1d8+22/18-20/x2)) or; 31 +3 spiked chain (shielding modification) +24 (2d4+10/x2) plus energy drain; (power attack, furious focus +24 (2d4+22/18-20/x2)) or; slam +21 (1d6+7/x2) plus energy drain; (power attack, furious focus +24 (1d6+15/18-20/x2) plus energy drain)
Ranged +3 composite longbow (+1 Str) (grapnel attachment modification) +24 (1d8+4/x3) plus energy drain; (deadly aim +20 (1d8+12/x3))
Special Attacks create spawn, energy drain (1 level, DC 21), focusing switch, quick change, rapid assault

COMBAT

Tradition Elven Duelist (Equipment x3, Duelist x1); PAM Cha

Barrage Sphere – Talents (see customized weapon composite longbow)

barrage (special attack action; two ranged attacks at -2 penalty; martial focus, four ranged attacks at -6 penalty)

Berserker Sphere – Talents Savage; (see customized weapon elven curveblade)

Savage; regain martial focus as an immediate upon reducing creature to 0 or less hit points with a melee or thrown weapon attack
berserking (16 temporary hit points, -2 AC)
brutal strike (special attack action; battered plus (exertion); martial focus, +26 damage)

Duelist Sphere – Talents (bleed) Open Vein; (see customized weapon elven curveblade)

blooded strike, (deal 4 bleed on attack action, do not provoke Attack of Opportunity on maneuvers vs. bleeding targets, apply one (bleed)); (bleed) DC 23
Open Vein (bleed); expend martial focus as an immediate action, +3d4 bleed that stacks with blooded strike

Equipment Sphere – Talents Finesse Fighting (x2), Unarmored Training; (discipline) Elvish Heritage

Elvish Heritage (discipline); gain elven weapon proficiencies
Finesse Fighting (x2); use Dexterity to attack, add 1/2 BAB to damage
Unarmored Training; gain +7 armor bonus that applies to touch

Sniper Sphere – Talents (see customized weapon composite longbow)

deadly shot (special attack action; add one (snipe); martial focus, +3d6 damage)

Customized Weapon Talents

elven curve blade; Talents Berserker sphere ((exertion) Heavy Swing); Duelist sphere (Long Cuts, Ooze Ichor; (bleed) Finger Cutter)
elven branched spear; Talents Fencing sphere (Fast Feint, Lunge); Lancer sphere
spiked chain; Talents Shield sphere (Bashing Shield, Deflecting Shield; (deflection) Redirecting Shield)
composite longbow; Talents Sniper sphere (Unblockable; (snipe) Pinning Shot); Barrage sphere (100,000 Arrows, Augmented Grip)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 26, Con -, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 20
Base Atk +13; CMB +14; CMD 34
Feats: Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Deadly Aim, Extra Prowess, Furious Focus, Improved Initiative, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +24, Intimidate +21, Perception +16, Profession (Soldier) +16
Languages Common, Elven
SQ combat training, customized weapons (4), prowess (deadly prowess, exotic weaponry, faith in steel, practiced initiative, transfigurative customization, variable prowess), enhanced customization (+3)
Other Gear amulet of natural armor +2, belt of incredible dexterity +4, cloak of resistance +2, mwk composite longbow (+1 Str) with 20 arrows, mwk elven branched spear, mwk elven curve blade, headband of alluring charisma +2, ring of protection +2, +1 keen spiked chain

ABOUT

A withered corpse that moves with unnerving grace, this elven warrior welcomes challengers with sadistic glee and sharpened blades.
